text: I can name the fields of a span and explain why one service call produces a CLIENT span and a SERVER span.
I can decode a W3C traceparent header and explain how context crosses HTTP calls, thread pools and a message queue.
I can compute trace storage from QPS, spans per trace and bytes per span, and compare head-based and tail-based sampling for error coverage and cost.
I can describe OpenTelemetry's API, SDK, OTLP and Collector, and say what it costs to adopt.
I can read a waterfall, follow the critical path, and use the CLIENT-to-SERVER gap to find time spent outside the callee.
